Mods in a Windows emulator

Some LF2 mods (Naruto: The Setting Dawn, for one) pack their program and game files into a protected .exe that OpenLF2 cannot read. This page plays them as they are, in BoxedWine: a Windows emulator that runs Wine in your browser. It is much slower than OpenLF2 and than a PC, and needs a recent desktop browser with plenty of memory.

The first start downloads the emulator with Wine (about 200 MB) and the mod from the online relay; your browser keeps them for later visits. Windows then takes a minute or more to start the game. Network play does not work here; everyone plays at one keyboard.

Click the game first, so that it gets your keys. The mod's own keys apply (data/control.txt): player 1 usually moves with W A S D and uses J attack, K jump, L defend; F1 pauses, Esc leaves a match.
